hero.headline: Premium Coffee
hero.sub: from the foothills of the Himalayas
hero.intro:
At Mewa Valley Coffee, we bring exceptional specialty coffee from Eastern Nepal to the world.

Based in the UK, we work closely with our dedicated sourcing team in Nepal to discover outstanding coffees from producers across the region. We carefully select each coffee for its quality, character and distinct sense of place, connecting Nepali producers with coffee businesses and drinkers beyond Nepal.
hero.alt: Cloud moving across a forested ridge in the hill districts of eastern Nepal, a dirt road cut into the slope

premise.title: Why Nepal?
premise.body1:
Nepal is better known for its mountains than its coffee. But among the hills below the Himalayas, coffee has been flourishing for decades.

Grown at elevations between roughly 800 and 1,600 metres, Nepalese coffee benefits from cool temperatures, distinct seasons and abundant monsoon rainfall. 

These conditions allow the cherries to develop slowly, building the foundations for complex and expressive coffees.
premise.body2: This is coffee shaped by Nepal’s landscape: carefully cultivated and unmistakably of its place.

coffee.title: What we offer
coffee.body1:
We are a UK based company with a dedicated team in Nepal. We source the very best of Nepali coffee, working with trusted and reputable producers. Our coffee goes through a rigorous quality testing and certification process before being delivered to your doorstep.

We work with Arabica beans, and within this, primarily Bourbon and Typica. These traditional varieties, combined with Nepal’s distinctive geography and climate, provide the foundation for coffees with clarity, sweetness and lively acidity. 

Nepali coffee represents huge untapped potential, with demand growing rapidly each year. The Eastern region is increasingly known for producing coffee of exceptional and outstanding quality. Assessed lots repeatedly score above 85 on the 50-100 SCA scale.

In 2020, Nepali Coffee scored 92 in a blind assessment review by Press House Coffee (Californian Trade Magazine), highlighting it as "delicate, balanced and sweet-toned".

We ensure the farmers who work very hard to produce this remarkable product get paid fairly. 1% of our profit goes directly back to the farmers.

about.title: About us
about.aboutBody1: The coffee we source grows in the foothills of the Himalaya. Nepal's climate suits it: cool dry winters, warm monsoon summers, and reliable rain at the point in the year the cherry needs it most.
about.aboutBody2: There is a young, fast-moving coffee culture in Nepal that Europe knows nothing about. We want to bring that community — and what it grows — to Britain.
about.hillAlt: Hills near Mewa Valley Coffee's sourcing districts in Nepal
about.mapAlt: Map of Mewa Valley Coffee's sourcing districts in Nepal
about.sourcingBody2: Between them our producers work across washed, natural and yellow honey processing. Predominantly Arabica, with some Robusta at lower altitude in parts of Koshi Province.
about.sourcingBody3: Growing altitudes run from roughly 800 to 1,600 metres. Higher up, the cherry ripens slowly — sugars concentrate and the bean comes out denser.
about.sourcingBody4: We are looking to work with roasters who find that as interesting as we do.
